title: Patient Financial Services Policy: One Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) per Encounter
content:
**Clause.** A patient may hold any number of Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) accounts at once. Registration opens one account per encounter, and one account per plan of care for a recurring outpatient therapy series. A new encounter is never merged into an existing account, and a recurring series is never split into per-visit accounts. The patient-class tier of an account is fixed by the registration type in its entry gate and is not changed after registration.

## The clause restated

| Situation | Accounts |
|---|---|
| Each separately registered visit, stay or procedure | one account each |
| A recurring outpatient therapy plan of care, however many visits it has | one account for the whole plan of care |
| A later encounter of a patient who already has open accounts | its own new account, never merged into an existing one |

The patient class an account received at registration (for example Emergency Department Visit Account or Observation Stay Account) stays the account's class for its whole life.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A patient seen in the emergency department in May and for an imaging study in June holds two accounts, one per encounter.
- A patient attending twelve physical therapy visits under one plan of care holds one Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account, not twelve.
- An account registered from a physician observation order remains an Observation Stay Account after registration.
